ideas.title: Dog walking and pet sitting (east)
ideas.one_liner: Working dog owners pay for weekday lunchtime walks and weekend pet sitting at home.

cost_breakdown.item: Leads, poo bags and first-aid kit

steps: Post on 25 neighbourhood boards this week
Offer a free first walk for one dog
Buy leads, bags and a first-aid kit
Set fixed lunchtime walking rounds
Ask the vet clinic to display a flyer
Send a photo update after every walk
Fill midday slots with weekend sitting
first_customers: Google Maps 4-star shops with unanswered reviews
pitfalls: Meet the dog and owner before accepting
Never walk more than 3 dogs at once
Confirm vaccination records before sitting
